scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The multiplier normalization is reconstructed from equations (3.9)--(3.17) of the primary source. The global inequality is proved by a positive power-series identity; finite numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The theorem concerns only the scale-invariant homogeneous s-wave multiplier. It does not determine the sharp upper constant below \(\gamma=52/27\) and does not assert a sharp upper constant for the full inhomogeneous form or Hamiltonian.

title: Sharp strong-repulsion upper constant for the regularized three-boson s-wave multiplier
